record.original_question: If X is a well-filtered determined T0 space, is its Smyth power space PS(X) also well-filtered determined? Here PS(X) is the upper Vietoris space on the nonempty compact saturated subsets of X.

evidence.quote: Question 6.5. ([51]) Is the Smyth power space PS(X) of a well-filtered determined T0 space X well-filtered determined?
The upper Vietoris topology on K(X) is the topology generated by {2U : U in O(X)} as a base, and the resulting space is called the Smyth power space or upper space of X and is denoted by PS(X).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a $T_0$ topological space. Denote by $\mathcal{O}(X)$ the lattice of open subsets of $X$, and by $K(X)$ the family of nonempty compact saturated subsets of $X$ (a subset is saturated if it equals the intersection of all open sets containing it). The Smyth power space $P_S(X)$ is the set $K(X)$ equipped with the upper Vietoris topology, namely the topology generated by the base
$$\{\,\Box U : U \in \mathcal{O}(X)\,\}, \qquad \Box U = \{K \in K(X) : K \subseteq U\}.$$
A $T_0$ space $Y$ is called well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i\}_{i\in I} \subseteq K(Y)$ (filtered under reverse inclusion) and every open set $U$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I} K_i \subseteq U$, there exists $i_0 \in I$ with $K_{i_0} \subseteq U$.

A continuous map $f : Y \to Z$ from a $T_0$ space $Y$ to a well-filtered $T_0$ space $Z$ is said to extend uniquely along the well-filtered reflection if it factors uniquely through the well-filtered reflection of $Y$. A $T_0$ space $Y$ is called well-filtered determined (WD) if for every continuous map $f : Y \to Z$ into a well-filtered $T_0$ space $Z$, $f$ extends uniquely to a continuous map from the well-filtered reflection of $Y$; equivalently, $Y$ admits a well-filtered reflection in the standard categorical sense in the category of $T_0$ spaces.

Question: If $X$ is a well-filtered determined $T_0$ space, must its Smyth power space $P_S(X)$ also be well-filtered determined?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches turned up the original problem and several follow-up works on well-filtered determined spaces, ω-Rudin spaces, and Smyth power constructions, but no source explicitly resolves the question of whether the Smyth power space of a well-filtered determined T0 space is itself well-filtered determined. The status from available evidence is inconclusive.
